hero.caption: Aerial view of Bell Labs Holmdel Complex. The Bell Labs building in Holmdel is an architectural heirloom, designed by renowned architect Eero Saarinen, with a proud and distinguished history.  For 44 years it was the home of an advanced research lab owned successively by Bell Telephone, AT&T, Lucent, and Alcatel.

images.filename: Green Banks - Jansky Antena.jpg
images.caption: Reconstruction of the directional antenna used in the discovery of radio emission from space by Karl Guthe Jansky at Bell Telephone Laboratories Holmdel, New Jersy, in 1932, which began the field of radio astronomy.  It is an 8 element Bruce array (a type of curtain array) resonant at 14 MHz, consisting of 8 wire dipoles in front of a wire screen reflector.  Now at National Radio Astronomy Observatory in Green Bank, West Virginia.
images.alt: Reconstruction of the directional antenna used in the discovery of radio emission from space by Karl Guthe Jansky at Bell Telephone Laboratories Holmdel, New Jersy, in 1932, which began the field of radio astronomy.  It is an 8 element Bruce array (a type of curtain array) resonant at 14 MHz, consisting of 8 wire dipoles in front of a wire screen reflector.  Now at National Radio Astronomy Observatory in Green Bank, West Virginia.
